name: Early College Program (ECP)
what_you_do: Take one real college course for four weeks on campus: English 101, Biology 100 or Dance 132. You earn four college credits with a grade of C or better.
who_can_apply: Female high school students in 11th grade with a 3.0 GPA and at least a 3.0 in English and science. Parent permission is required. One page also says juniors and seniors, so confirm your grade.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 29, 2027 and close Mar 29, 2027. No late submissions accepted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer Programs Interest Form for news. Then apply in the online portal when it opens Jan 29, 2027.
notes: Costs money. The Mar 29 closing date is on the main summer programs page; the ECP page itself does not give a due date.
